_comment: Guardian Angel lines. Keyed by dialogue id referenced in rooms.json. Tone: gentle, scriptural cadence, never preachy. Each entry is an ordered list of lines shown one at a time.
intro: You are awake in a place outside of time.
It has one law: do only what you were meant to do.
Stray from the path and the timeline will branch — and a branch is never free.
Pray at the altar. I will meet you further down.
first_rift_warning: That tear in the air is a rift. It is a road you were not given.
Step through and another you begins. It will come looking.
If you must, an altar can seal it — and forgive it.
watched_threshold: Find an altar. Set down what you've diverged before it sets down on you.
ending_router: What you did not do has kept you. Or what you took has claimed you.
The Warden will decide. Stand, Pilgrim.

sanctified: You did only what you were meant to do.
The Warden lowers its spear. The way up opens.
pardoned: You strayed. You also turned back.
That turning is not nothing. I will speak for you.
The way up opens — narrow, but open.
branched: You did what you were not meant to do.
The timeline keeps its branches. And its people.
Rest now. Someone else will wake in the cell.
